name: Remote Monitoring
author: OmniPull Team
description: A lightweight FastAPI server that exposes your download list over HTTP. View real-time progress from any device on your network via a polished Tailwind CSS dashboard — no extra software required.

name: Auto Organiser
author: OmniPull Team
description: Automatically moves completed downloads into subfolders categorised by file type, date, or custom rules. Keeps your Downloads directory tidy.

name: Smart Library
author: OmniPull Team
description: Turn downloaded content into a browsable library with metadata, thumbnails, and search functionality. Perfect for managing ebooks, videos, or music collections. Almost like a mini media manager.

name: YT-DLP Power User
author: OmniPull Team
description: Extend OmniPull with the full features of ytdlp - advanced format selection, custom post-processing, and support for obscure sites. Unleash the true power of ytdlp within OmniPull's interface.
